title: Reading Drill — A Local Catalogue for Repair Parts
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Local Catalogue for Repair Parts
passages.body:
**A** A group catalogued spare parts bought for common repairs. At first the catalogue listed products by seller, but volunteers wanted to find a part by size even when its seller was unknown.

**B** Labelled compartments helped, although pieces that looked similar still became mixed. Volunteers attached a small ruler to the box so new members could compare items immediately.

**C** The finished catalogue gave examples of compatible models. A separate field marked when a part had an uncertain fit, which helped the team avoid promising a repair prematurely.
